nodes.label: FetchResult Typed Fetch Outcome (ok/empty/failed)
nodes.rationale: Frozen dataclass with Literal status and three constructors. The three states each demand a different freshness row (success with rows, success with zero rows, failed); conflating them was the original sin behind 'the dashboard says everything is green but no exports loaded'.

nodes.label: ScraperShapeError Pattern
nodes.rationale: Raised by HTML scrapers when the upstream page no longer matches the expected structure, instead of returning empty DataFrames. Subclasses ValueError so existing except blocks still catch it, but lets the dashboard distinguish 'no data this week' from 'the scraper is broken'.

nodes.label: Shared retry_sleep Backoff with Jitter
nodes.rationale: Single exponential-backoff formula (capped 30s, 0-1s jitter) replacing nine copies of time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY). Jitter matters because the 18-layer pipeline otherwise produces synchronised retry storms against shared upstreams (USDA, FRED, EIA).

nodes.label: _mark_empty vs _mark_failed Freshness Distinction
nodes.rationale: _mark_failed writes status='failed' preserving prior last_success (powers 'last good run was N days ago'); _mark_empty writes status='success', rows_fetched=0 for legitimately-empty weeks. Before this, empty was indistinguishable from never-ran and failed from succeeded.

nodes.label: Stocks-to-Use Ratio Signal
nodes.rationale: Ending-stocks / total-use per commodity with detect_tight_supply() flagging bottom-decile years. Sourced from the PSD frame rather than direct WASDE numbers because NASS QuickStats does not expose ending stocks and total use in a stable queryable shape; PSD carries both country-keyed with WASDE-consistent definitions.

nodes.label: Shared Z-Score Helpers (COT + Weather)
nodes.rationale: zscore(series, window) and format_zscore(z) factored out of two callers rolling their own. COT section flags positioning at |z| >= 2 instead of a fixed net-position threshold that missed regime shifts in low-OI contracts; weather section annotates anomaly z-scores alongside threshold breaches.

nodes.label: Brazil Export Basis (compute_brazil_basis)
nodes.rationale: CBOT (USD/MT) vs CEPEA/AgRural (USD/MT after BRL FX conversion). Negative basis = Brazilian beans below CBOT in dollar terms (export-competitive discount). AgRural Paranagua FOB was added because CEPEA covers interior spot while the export-basis question is about FOB-at-port; the two differ by the inland-freight wedge.

nodes.label: Briefing Archive (briefings table + snapshot_json)
nodes.rationale: Every briefing run persists text plus a structured snapshot_json distilled from BriefingData. Enables backtesting questions like 'what did we say last Tuesday when the dollar broke 105' without re-running against a moved-on database, and unblocks signal recall@N analysis before promoting new rules to alert severity.

nodes.label: CONAB Fetcher Schema Rewrite (Layer 15)
nodes.rationale: CONAB switched SerieHistoricaGraos.txt to a semicolon-separated per-UF schema; the old fetcher silently parsed it as one column and every row was discarded. Rewrite parses sep=';', aggregates 27 UF rows to national totals, recomputes yield from aggregated production/area, and hard-fails with logger.error listing received columns if the schema drifts again.

nodes.label: Batch executemany Upsert Refactor
nodes.rationale: Replaced 19 per-row iterrows writers with one batch executemany helper inside a transaction: 7.5-8.5x speedup and store.py halved (979 to 471 LOC). Freshness and save_wasde defaulting logic kept verbatim because they carry non-trivial business rules.

edges.source_location: the three FetchResult states each demand a different freshness row
AgRural Paranagua FOB fetcher feeds the Brazil basis section
basis stores raw BRL/MT and converts to USD/MT at the derived-display layer
both address upstream-failure resilience: jittered retries vs per-layer graceful degradation
both convert silent upstream-shape drift into loud, diagnosable failures via different mechanisms
batch upsert runs through the same connection abstraction (validated by Turso integration tests)
